verdict.rationale: Channel3's pricing docs say agents can pay for API usage via MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) without an API key or signup. That is a first-party, agent-initiated payment rail. However, the evidence never states that MPP settlement happens in stablecoins, and it provides no rail documentation beyond a single line. Missing for 10: explicit stablecoin settlement evidence, documentation of the MPP payment flow and rails, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can settle agent-initiated payments in stablecoins over documented rails

citations.quote: Agents can pay via MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) — no API key or signup required.
